resources.string: An earlier key on this device opened the set-aside data again, so it is back. Data saved in the meantime was kept unchanged next to it.
The app was closed while restoring a backup. Your previous data has been put back; nothing from the backup was kept.
The app was closed while restoring a backup, and the previous data could not be put back completely. Please check your watchlist and portfolio, or restore the backup again under “%1$s” in Settings.
The backup file could not be verified after saving – it reads back differently. Please save the backup to a new file.
Acquired before 1 Mar 2021 – held ≤ 1 year: exemption limit for speculative transactions (§ 31 (3) EStG old version)
Counts as income when received (Austria). Leave off for staking rewards and airdrops.
Set up a screen lock to open the portfolio.
Without a screen lock the portfolio cannot be unlocked. Turned off, the app shows your portfolio again without asking. Once a screen lock is set up, you can turn the lock back on in Settings.
